mainEntity.name: What should I understand before using the site or contacting Immigrate to Brazil?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should understand that the site provides general information and contact pathways, while case-specific guidance depends on your actual facts and a proper review.

mainEntity.name: Does the website create a client relationship by itself?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Reading the site or sending a first message does not by itself create a formal client relationship.

mainEntity.name: Can I rely on the site instead of case-specific guidance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The site is useful for orientation, but important decisions should be based on your actual situation rather than general public information alone.

mainEntity.name: How does Immigrate to Brazil handle third-party services or links?

acceptedAnswer.text: Third-party services or links may be relevant, but they do not replace direct guidance on your own situation or create control over outside services.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I need clarification before using a service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact the team directly. It is better to clarify expectations early than to proceed on the basis of guesswork.
